_meta.note: OFFICER CONTACTS are taken from the official CPGRAMS Nodal Public Grievance Officers directory. CATEGORY NAMES are still seed data and have NOT been checked against the live portal dropdowns - do that by filing one grievance manually and screenshotting every level.

email_kind.role: A durable departmental role account. Safe to use; survives postholder changes.
email_kind.individual: A named officer's address. Correct today, but these rotate - re-check against the source before a long campaign.
email_kind.none: No published address. The agent must not invent one; the email rung is skipped and it falls through to phone or portal.

out_of_scope.note: CPGRAMS covers CENTRAL government. These belong elsewhere and the router must say so rather than misfile.
examples: State police, local FIR, traffic challans -> state grievance portal
Municipal water, garbage, potholes, street lights -> city/municipal portal
State electricity boards -> state discom portal
Private company disputes with no central regulator -> consumer commission
Court matters, pending litigation -> not admissible as a grievance
RTI requests -> RTI Online portal, a different mechanism entirely
